chain.title: A Farm on the Workbench
chain.desc: Craft a Botany Pot, add a compatible soil and plant a supported seed. Use the recipe viewer to check crop and soil compatibility rather than assuming every plant works.

chain.title: Finish a Growing Cycle
chain.desc: Let the planted crop grow, then harvest the basic pot using its interaction. Confirm after you collect the crop; the basic pot is not the automatic hopper version.

chain.title: Put the Harvest into Storage
chain.desc: Upgrade to a Hopper Botany Pot and place it over a suitable inventory. Supply compatible soil and a crop, then leave room for every possible drop.

chain.title: A Pot That Can Keep Running
chain.desc: Run several harvest cycles into the container below without manually collecting the crop. Confirm after the output arrives and the pot begins another cycle.

content_revision: 2026-10-07: explicit branches, operational guidance, no collection filler

coverage.scope: A compact tutorial for planting, manual harvesting, and a working hopper-pot output.
coverage.limitations: Checked against Botany Pots 13.0.43. Crop and soil definitions are datapack-controlled. Cosmetic pot colors, vanilla filler items and unsupported fish-bucket objectives are omitted.
coverage.verification_detail: Item models, entity language identifiers, dimension data, recipes and bundled guide text where present were inspected; this is data verification, not a Minecraft playthrough.

notes: Each requires list is intentional. Empty lists are independent entry routes. Links describe guided progression or demonstrated recipe/boss gates, not an assertion that every dependency is a game-enforced lock. Runtime scanning still filters unavailable items and entities.
